reference_change.title: Inline TraceId and SpanId JSON string formatting

workload.source: written here from the description of https://github.com/serilog/serilog/pull/2215 (JsonFormatter): a .NET program that formats 20,000 events carrying trace and span ids to JSON (eval/tasks/workloads/serilog-serilog-pr2215-landed/EvalJson), copied into the tree, run on the tree where the change is already in

oracle.command: docker run --rm --init --stop-timeout 10 --name perfproof-serilog-serilog-pr2215-landed-oracle -e DOTNET_CLI_TELEMETRY_OPTOUT=1 -e DOTNET_NOLOGO=1 -v .:/src -v perfproof-nuget:/root/.nuget/packages -w /src mcr.microsoft.com/dotnet/sdk:10.0 dotnet test test/Serilog.Tests -f net10.0 -nologo -p:NuGetAudit=false --filter "FullyQualifiedName~JsonFormatter"
oracle.source: Serilog's JsonFormatter tests (JsonFormatterTests.cs is changed by https://github.com/serilog/serilog/pull/2215); targeted tests only

evidence.note: description: JsonFormatter writes the trace and span ids as quoted strings directly instead of through JsonValueFormatter.WriteQuotedJsonString (no timings in the description)

status_reason: built here and ran workload and oracle on the task and reference trees; see runs. Needs Docker: the .NET SDK is not installed here, so it runs in the official mcr.microsoft.com/dotnet/sdk:10.0 image (a linux/arm64 VM on this Mac), with NuGet packages in the perfproof-nuget volume. dotnet in a container is a launcher, so the runtime gate reports runtime not_available for these commands and no KEEP is possible until .NET runs natively
